name: radmail
description: An email operating system for agents. Two-axis importance x urgency triage, per-sender behavioral learning, explainable 'why surfaced', autonomous follow-through on commitments, search to find the one message by sender/subject/content (no filesystem grep), and a deterministic BEC firewall: money, changed-banking, first-contact, decision, and prompt-injection are human-only forever.
auth: optional — omit the token and a free sandbox tenant is auto-provisioned

connectedMode.note: READ-ONLY connected mode ships in the radmail-mcp package (stdio): set the RADMAIL_API_KEY env var (get a key at https://app.radmail.ai/settings/api-keys) and `search`, `list_right_now`, and `list_commitments` (each with `messages` omitted) plus `read_email`, `read_thread`, `list_emails`, `list_prepared_drafts` and `list_watched_threads` operate on your REAL RadMail inbox via the v1 API. The read tools never send, draft against, or change real mail; the BEC hard-stops stay human-only forever. The package's own hosted /api/mcp endpoint can accept a per-request Authorization: Bearer key as a PREVIEW (read tools only) that is OFF by default: only when its operator sets RADMAIL_HOSTED_BEARER=1; while off, a bearer is ignored and the endpoint is sandbox-only. The zero-auth sandbox endpoint at radmail.ai stays key-less and does not expose `read_email`.

optInInboxActions.status: opt-in, local stdio only, off by default
envVars: RADMAIL_TRIAGE_API_KEY (a separate key with the triage scope)
optInInboxActions.note: Change inbox state only — archive, snooze, read state, labels. No trash, no delete, no send. Never registered on a hosted endpoint.

productionEngine.note: This package runs the SANDBOX engine (heuristic, in-memory, free, no creds). Real and runnable; the production multi-tenant '99%' engine is launch-gated.

compliancePosture: a tool, not a guarantee — BAA + shared responsibility. Never 'HIPAA-certified' or 'FedRAMP-authorized'.
